title: Connect to PostgreSQL
description: As a database designer, I want to connect with host, port, database, user, password, and schema so that I can work with a live database.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid connection parameters, when I test the connection, then success is reported
Given invalid parameters, when I test, then a specific, actionable error is shown (auth, DNS, timeout, permissions, version)
Given a session, then credentials exist only in memory

statusHistory.reason: Ticket created from PRD US-3.1 (fills STORY-012 numbering gap; TASK-036, TASK-037, TASK-038 already reference this parent)

evidence.description: Added permissions (SQLSTATE 42501) -> HTTP 401 handling; added PostgreSQL 14+ version check via current_setting('server_version_num') -> HTTP 400 with actionable message; fixed frontend connectionApi to surface backend 'error' field so descriptive errors reach the user; added unit tests for permissions/version/error surfacing.

commands: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -e NODE_ENV=test -v $PROJECT_DIR/backend:/work:rw -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c 'npx vitest run src/services/connection-test.service.test.ts src/routes/test-connection.test.ts src/__tests__/test-connection.unit.test.ts'

docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -e NODE_ENV=test -v $PROJECT_DIR/backend:/work:rw -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c 'npx tsc --noEmit'

evidence.description: All tests run inside Docker containers per docker-test-runner skill; nothing run on the host. Throwaway postgres:16 container on private network with generated password; container and network removed after integration run.

results.outcome: 4 passed (valid->200, invalid password->401, unreachable host->5xx, missing field->400)

coverage: AC1 valid -> success: verified (unit + live integration returned 200)
AC2 invalid -> actionable error: auth (401), DNS/network (502), timeout (504), permissions 42501 (401), version <14 (400) all handled and tested; password redacted in errors
AC3 credentials only in memory: verified (password never logged/persisted/echoed; tests assert non-leakage)

testResults.scope: backend integration vs live postgres:16 (independent re-run)
testResults.outcome: 4 passed (valid->200, invalid password->401, unreachable host->5xx, missing field->400)

findings: Production route POST /api/v1/connections/test uses testConnectionHandler -> testConnection from connection-test.service.ts (new service with all STORY-012 features)
Error categorization correct: network (ECONNREFUSED/ENOTFOUND/etc.) -> 502, auth (28P01/28000/42501/3D000/53300) -> 401, timeout (ETIMEDOUT/timeout) -> 504, version <14 -> 400, unexpected -> 500
Password sanitized via sanitizeErrorMessage (split/join with ***), never in error responses or logs
Bounded connection timeout via Promise.race with connectionTimeoutMillis fallback
Connection always closed in catch/finally blocks
Frontend connectionApi.ts surfaces backend 'error' field; password never echoed to client
ConnectionForm password field has type=password and autocomplete=off
useConnection.disconnect() clears credentials (config set to null)
Minor observation: duplicate postgres-connection.service.ts lacks version check (pre-existing tech debt, out of scope for this ticket)
architectureReview.conclusion: Implementation meets all acceptance criteria. Architecture is sound. Approved.
